description: This Java source file contains automated API integration tests for employee workflows within the OrangeHRM system. It tests CRUD operations on job titles and pagination/business-logic validations using the RestAssured library.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkflowTests
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying employee workflow API endpoints and business logic in OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: createAndDeleteJobTitle
methods.description: Tests the creation and subsequent deletion of a job title entry via API, validating success and list integrity.

methods.name: paginationValidation
methods.description: Validates that pagination parameters (limit and offset) are correctly enforced by the API endpoint.

methods.name: deleteValidationShouldFailOnEmptyIds
methods.description: Ensures that deleting with an empty list of IDs results in an error (status 400 or 422).
